title: Initiatives
body: A big bet the team is pursuing. An HQDM `activity`. Its point totals roll up from the Features that reference it.

title: Total points
body: Sum of `points` across every Feature that references this initiative — a rollup, recomputed on the server whenever a child feature changes.

title: Shipped points
body: Sum of each Feature's `shippedPoints` (a rollup of a computed column): points that have actually shipped.

title: Feature count
body: How many Features reference this initiative (a count rollup over the `features` relation).

title: Initiative → Features
body: Each Feature names its initiative; this relation lets an Initiative roll up its Features.
